arxiv-2303-15150.title: High-dimensional frequency conversion in hot atomic system
arxiv-2303-15150.creator: Wei-Hang Zhang, Ying-Hao Ye, Lei Zeng, En-Ze Li, Jing-Yuan Peng, Dong-Sheng Ding, Bao-Sen Shi
arxiv-2303-15150.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wei-Hang Zhang, Ying-Hao Ye, Lei Zeng, En-Ze Li, Jing-Yuan Peng, Dong-Sheng Ding, Bao-Sen Shi. One of the major difficulties in realizing a high-dimensional frequency converter for conventional optical vortex (COV) stems from the difference in ring diameter of COV modes with different topological charge numbers l l . Here, we implement a high-dimensional frequency convertor for perfect optical vortex (POV) modes with invariant size through the four-wave mixing (FWM) process by utilizing Bessel-Gaussian beams instead of Laguerre-Gaussian beams.

arxiv-2502-11074.title: Trace Ratio vs Ratio Trace Methods for Multidimensional Dimensionality Reduction
arxiv-2502-11074.creator: A. Zahir, F. Dufrenois, K. Jbilou, A. Ratnani
arxiv-2502-11074.description: Abstract We propose a higher-order dimensionality reduction framework based on the Trace Ratio (TR) optimization problem. We establish conditions for existence and uniqueness of solutions and clarify the theoretical connection between the Trace Ratio and its surrogate, the Ratio Trace (RT) formulation.

arxiv-2509-08145.title: Estimating Peer Effects Using Partial Network Data
arxiv-2509-08145.creator: Vincent Boucher
arxiv-2509-08145.description: Abstract We study the estimation of peer effects through social networks when researchers do not observe the entire network structure. Special cases include sampled networks, censored networks, and misclassified links. We assume that researchers can obtain a consistent estimator of the distribution of the network. We show that this assumption is sufficient for estimating peer effects using a linear-in-means model.

arxiv-2512-02972.title: BEVDilation: LiDAR-Centric Multi-Modal Fusion for 3D Object Detection
arxiv-2512-02972.creator: Guowen Zhang, Chenhang He, Liyi Chen, Lei Zhang
arxiv-2512-02972.description: Abstract Integrating LiDAR and camera information in the bird’s eye view (BEV) representation has demonstrated its effectiveness in 3D object detection. However, because of the fundamental disparity in geometric accuracy between these sensors, indiscriminate fusion in previous methods often leads to degraded performance. In this paper, we propose BEVDilation, a novel LiDAR-centric framework that prioritizes LiDAR information in the fusion.

pmc-10523440.creator: Javier A Cabeza, Felipe García, Pablo García-Álvarez, Rubén García-Soriano, Enrique Pérez-Carreño
pmc-10523440.description: The bis(amidinato)-heavier tetrylenes E(bzamP)2 (E = Ge (2a) and Sn (2b); bzamP = N-isopropyl-N′-(diphenylphosphanylethyl)benzamidinate), which are equipped with one heavier tetrylene (germylene or stannylene) and two phosphane fragments (one on each amidinate moiety) as coordinable groups, have been synthesized from the benzamidinum salt [H2bzamP]Cl and GeCl2(dioxane) or SnCl2 in 2:1 mol ratio.

pmc-12361451.title: Dynamically tunable long-range coupling enabled by bound state in the continuum
pmc-12361451.creator: Haijun Tang, Can Huang, Yuhan Wang, Xiong Jiang, Ruiheng Jin, Yue Cui, Shumin Xiao, Qinghai Song
pmc-12361451.description: Formation and dynamic control of strong coupling among cavities are essential to realize advanced functional photonic and quantum circuits. Especially for cavities at distant distance or arbitrary locations. Conventional approaches suffer from short coupling distance, poor controllability, fixed locations and low wavelength uniformity, significantly restricting the scalability of photonic and quantum networks.

pmc-12564151.title: PAX6 Downregulation Triggers HIF-1α-Mediated Ferroptosis in Glioma Cells
pmc-12564151.creator: Qizhi Luo, Li Fu, Jie Zhang, Shashuang Zhang, Lixiang Wu, Quan Zhu, Baisheng Huang, Anna Martina Battaglia
pmc-12564151.description: Background: The paired-box gene 6 (PAX6) is an important transcription factor in the central nervous system, mainly regulating the development and differentiation of embryonic eyes and the nervous system. PAX6 expression is significantly decreased in glioma, and the expression levels are closely related to glioma development and prognosis.

pmc-12603085.title: SE-Res-U-Net: an improved U-Net architecture for efficient sleep state detection and classification
pmc-12603085.creator: Ghulam Irtaza, Naila Sammar Naz, Muhammad Usman Saeed, A. S. Shflot, Ahsanullah Unar
pmc-12603085.description: Sleep state detection and classification play a critical role in understanding sleep patterns and diagnosing related disorders. Traditional methods like polysomnography are accurate but labor-intensive, time-consuming, and reliant on manual intervention, which limits their scalability for large-scale or home-based applications. This study proposes an improved 1D U-Net model for efficient and accurate sleep state detection and classification.

pmc-13003323.title: Oncogenic GPR161 Drives Melanoma Proliferation and Metabolic Activity through TXNIP Inhibition
pmc-13003323.creator: Yuna Roh, Jinhyeon Choi, Jin-Seong Hwang, Yeo-Jin Lee, Taesang Son, Sarang Kim, Nayeon Gu, Hyun Seung Ban, Eunsun Jung, Jang-Seong Kim, Tae-Su Han
pmc-13003323.description: Melanoma progression is driven by both oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming; however, the roles of G-protein–coupled receptors (GPCRs) in these processes remain unclear. Here, we identified GPR161 as an oncogenic GPCR that is significantly upregulated in melanoma and associated with poor survival in advanced-stage melanoma.

pmc-13156858.title: LDHC4 drives lung adenocarcinoma progression by inducing lactylation of RB1 at lysine 900 to disrupt the RB1–E2F1 complex
pmc-13156858.creator: Wei Peng, Zhi Lin, Cheng Sun, Lingjing Lin, Zhaolei Cui, Donghong Lin
pmc-13156858.description: BackgroundThe metabolic enzyme lactate dehydrogenase C4 (LDHC4) is aberrantly expressed in cancers and linked to poor prognosis. However, its role in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and the molecular mechanisms beyond glycolysis remain unclear. This study investigates whether LDHC4 promotes LUAD by modulating protein lactylation, a lactate-derived post-translational modification, focusing on the tumor suppressor retinoblastoma protein (RB1).

pmc-13288669.title: Active deformation in the basal organ of Corti in gerbil
pmc-13288669.creator: Kaitlyn H. Wong, C. Elliott Strimbu, Elizabeth S. Olson
pmc-13288669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Optical coherence tomography has allowed in vivo recording of sound-induced vibrations of different regions within the organ of Corti complex (OCC), including the basilar membrane (BM), outer hair cell/Deiters cell (OHC/DC) region, and reticular lamina (RL).

pmc-13493784.title: Probabilistic deep learning framework for dynamic carbon emission accounting of electric buses under grid uncertainty
pmc-13493784.creator: Shaoxuan Zhu, Guolin Lü, Chenhao Zhi, Shuhong Liu, Chenhao Li, Kai Zhang
pmc-13493784.description: The electrification of public transit has emerged as a pivotal pathway for deep urban decarbonization. However, existing carbon accounting methods predominantly rely on static grid emission factors and deterministic energy models, often overlooking spatiotemporal variability and uncertainty propagation. To address this limitation, this study establishes a dynamic, uncertainty-aware framework for the carbon accounting of electric bus systems.

pmc-13655645.title: Physicochemical Stability and Sensory Properties of Salad Dressing Formulated With Fish Oil‐in‐Water Pickering Emulsions
pmc-13655645.creator: Thang Tran, Grethe Hyldig, Betül Yesiltas, Ana C. Mendes, Ioannis S. Chronakis, Charlotte Jacobsen
pmc-13655645.description: Pickering emulsions stabilized with food‐grade particles have gained attention for food applications to deliver bioactive compounds. Fish oil, a rich source of omega‐3 PUFAs, offers numerous health benefits, but it is highly prone to lipid oxidation. While fish oil Pickering emulsions have shown potential in enhancing oxidative stability, their application in real food systems has not been explored extensively.
